headline: A cybersecurity official in Singapore says AI is giving attackers an advantage for the moment.
score_reason: Pool score 5; fact check suggests 4: unverified, only the headline could be read and no other outlet carries the story.
importance_line: It adds a Singapore cyber official's view to the debate over whether AI helps attackers or defenders more, but who the official is, what evidence supports the view and how long 'for now' lasts are not yet known.
summary: The Wall Street Journal reports that a Singapore cyber official says artificial intelligence gives cyberattackers an edge for now.
notes: Headline only. WSJ page blocked (401 bot challenge); no other outlet found carrying the story after several Google News searches.
